name: io.github.AytuncYildizli/yapitalism
title: Yapitalism
description: Drive terminal coding agents by voice. Lists and reads tmux and Superset panes, sends instructions into them, and returns a receipt that never claims more than it proved: GREEN only when the agent echoes a one-time marker, YELLOW when the write landed but processing was not proven.

packageArguments.name: --stdio
packageArguments.description: Speak MCP over stdin/stdout rather than binding a port.
